issuing_authority.quote: the State Board of Medical Licensure shall mail a notice of renewal of license to every physician or osteopath

moral_character_required.quote: If the applicant is found by the board, upon examination, to possess sufficient learning in those branches and to be of good moral character, the board shall issue him a license to practice medicine

exams.name: Board examination (methods deemed most practical and expeditious)
exams.notes: The statute requires the board to examine applicants by methods it deems most practical and expeditious; the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact references USMLE and COMLEX-USA for expedited licensure.
exams.quote: every person who desires to obtain a license to practice medicine must apply therefor, in writing, to the State Board of Medical Licensure at least ten (10) days before the date of the examination and must be examined by the board according to the methods deemed by it to be the most practical and expeditious to test the applicants' qualifications.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Required only for expedited licensure under the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, not for standard licensure.
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three (3) attempts

exams.name: Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA)
exams.notes: Required only for expedited licensure under the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, not for standard licensure.
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or the Comprehensive Osteopathic Medical Licensing Examination (COMLEX-USA) within three (3) attempts

interval_years.quote: the license of every person licensed to practice medicine or osteopathy in the State of Mississippi shall be renewed annually.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: submit it to the board in the manner prescribed by the board in the notice before June 30 with the renewal fee of an amount established by the board, but not to exceed Three Hundred Dollars ($300.00)

available.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may grant license to practice medicine without examination as to learning to graduates in medicine or osteopathic medicine who hold license to practice medicine from another state, provided the requirements in such state are equal to those required by the State Board of Medical Licensure.

requirements.value: License without examination may be granted to graduates who hold a license from another state with equal requirements, or to diplomates of the National Board of Medical Examiners or NBEO, or to Licentiates of the Medical Council of Canada from LCME-accredited schools. Military applicants and spouses may also receive expedited recognition under the Military Family Freedom Act (73-50-1).
requirements.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may grant license to practice medicine without examination as to learning to graduates in medicine or osteopathic medicine who hold license to practice medicine from another state, provided the requirements in such state are equal to those required by the State Board of Medical Licensure.

exists.quote: There is hereby created and established a board to be known as the state board of medical licensure.

national_certification.value: National Board of Medical Examiners; National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons
national_certification.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure may affiliate with and recognize for the purpose of waiving examination diplomates of the National Board of Medical Examiners, or the National Board of Examiners for Osteopathic Physicians and Surgeons

national_association.value: American Medical Association; Association of American Medical Colleges; Liaison Committee on Medical Education
national_association.quote: accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, as sponsored by the American Medical Association and the Association of American Medical Colleges

title_protection.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of medicine across state lines (telemedicine) in this state, hold himself out as qualified to do the same, or use any title, word or abbreviation to indicate to or induce others to believe that he is duly licensed to practice medicine across state lines in this state unless he has first obtained a license to do so

scope_protection.quote: Every person who desires to practice medicine must first obtain a license to do so from the state board of medical licensure

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs or other addiction-forming/sustaining drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual personal use of narcotic drugs, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors to an extent affecting professional competency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual use of intoxicating liquors, or any beverage, to an extent which affects professional competency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing narcotics outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any narcotic drug, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability otherwise than in the course of legitimate professional practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or aiding in an abortion that is not medically indicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or attempting to procure, or aiding in, an abortion that is not medically indicated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license by fraud or deception.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in the statute, including false names, assisting unlicensed practice, fraudulent representations, etc.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, which includes, but is not limited to: Practicing medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner, living or dead.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal or revocation of license by another state or jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state or jurisdiction to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice medicine in that jurisdiction or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of license or medical staff membership while under disciplinary investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under disciplinary investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Final sanctions imposed by HHS Office of Inspector General for incompetency, gross misconduct, or failure to meet professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Final sanctions imposed by the United States Department of Health and Human Services, Office of Inspector General or any successor federal agency or office, based upon a finding of incompetency, gross misconduct or failure to meet professionally recognized standards of health care

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish the board with legally requested information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the board, its investigators or representatives information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the Medical Practice Act or board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision(s) of the Medical Practice Act or the rules and regulations of the board or of any order, stipulation or agreement with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of deceptive advertisement provisions for health care practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation(s) of the provisions of Sections 41-121-1 through 41-121-9 relating to deceptive advertisement by health care practitioners.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetency in the practice of medicine or surgery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetency in the practice of medicine or surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having disciplinary action taken by peers within a professional medical association or by a licensed hospital
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having disciplinary action taken by his peers within any professional medical association or society, whether any such association or society is local, regional, state or national in scope, or being disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of said hospital

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety due to mental illness, physical illness, or excessive drug/alcohol use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: inability of the licensee to practice medicine with reasonable skill or safety to patients by reason of one or more of the following: Mental illness; Physical illness, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skill; Excessive use or abuse of drugs, including alcohol.

definition_quote.value: The practice of medicine shall mean to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery, after having received, or with the intent of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any bonus, gift, profit or compensation
definition_quote.quote: The practice of medicine shall mean to suggest, recommend, prescribe, or direct for the use of any person, any drug, medicine, appliance, or other agency, whether material or not material, for the cure, relief, or palliation of any ailment or disease of the mind or body, or for the cure or relief of any wound or fracture or other bodily injury or deformity, or the practice of obstetrics or midwifery, after having received, or with the intent of receiving therefor, either directly or indirectly, any bonus, gift, profit or compensation

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense drugs as part of the practice of medicine. Prescribing narcotics outside the course of legitimate professional practice is a disciplinary ground. Telemedicine prescribing requires a Mississippi license.
drug_authority.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any narcotic drug, or any other drug having addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability otherwise than in the course of legitimate professional practice.

license_status_types.quote: the executive officer of the state board of medical licensure may issue under his signature a temporary license to practice medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates may receive a limited institutional license (up to 5 years) for practice in Mississippi state-supported institutions if approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG). Full licensure requires ECFMG certification and passing the Flex Examination.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: The State Board of Medical Licensure is hereby authorized and empowered to grant limited institutional license for the practice of medicine in state institutions to graduates of foreign medical colleges approved by the National Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or its successor

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telemedicine practice requires a Mississippi medical license except when the evaluation is requested by a Mississippi-licensed physician who has already established a doctor-patient relationship with the patient.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of medicine across state lines (telemedicine) in this state, hold himself out as qualified to do the same, or use any title, word or abbreviation to indicate to or induce others to believe that he is duly licensed to practice medicine across state lines in this state unless he has first obtained a license to do so from the State Board of Medical Licensure

telemedicine_license_available.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of medicine across state lines (telemedicine) in this state...unless he has first obtained a license to do so from the State Board of Medical Licensure and has met all educational and licensure requirements as determined by the State Board of Medical Licensure.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into by this state with any and all states legally joining in the Compact in accordance with its terms

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: anybody taking action as set forth in this paragraph shall report such action to the board within thirty (30) days of its occurrence.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: a portion of which fee shall be used to support a program to aid impaired physicians and osteopaths

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the state board of medical licensure has reasonable cause to believe that a physician licensed to practice medicine in this state is unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of a condition described in Section 73-25-53, such board of medical licensure shall cause an examination of such physician to be made

investigational_drug_protection.quote: Except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct, civil immunity shall apply to any licensed physician or licensed pharmacist who prescribes or makes recommendation to an eligible patient regarding prescription for or treatment with an investigational drug, biological product or device under the provisions of Section 41-131-1, and the State Board of Medical Licensure and/or the State Board of Pharmacy, as the case may be, shall be prohibited from taking any adverse action against the license of such physician or pharmacist based solely on the physician's action under the provisions of Section 41-131-1.
